title: Yield chart
passage:
Can we review the yield chart before the shift ends?
A. The chart is made of paper.
B. Yes, let us meet at four thirty.
C. I ended it with a period.
passageZh:
我們可以在這個班別結束前檢視良率圖表嗎？
A. 圖表是紙做的。
B. 可以，我們四點半碰面。
C. 我用句點結尾。
